verses.original: וַֽעֲתַלְיָה֙ אֵ֣ם אֲחַזְיָ֔הוּ וְרָאֲתָה כִּ֣י מֵ֣ת בְּנָ֑הּ וַתָּ֙קָם֙ וַתְּאַבֵּ֔ד אֵ֖ת כָּל־ זֶ֥רַע הַמַּמְלָכָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wa·‘ă·ṯal·yāh ’êm ’ă·ḥaz·yā·hū wə·rå̄·ʾă·ṯå̄h kî mêṯ bə·nāh wat·tā·qām wat·tə·’ab·bêḏ ’êṯ kāl- ze·ra‘ ham·mam·lā·ḵāh
verses.literal: When Athaliah the mother of Ahaziah saw that her son was dead she proceeded to annihilate all the royal heirs

verses.original: וַתִּקַּ֣ח יְהוֹשֶׁ֣בַע בַּת־ הַמֶּֽלֶךְ־ י֠וֹרָם אֲח֨וֹת אֲחַזְיָ֜הוּ אֶת־ יוֹאָ֣שׁ בֶּן־ אֲחַזְיָ֗ה וַתִּגְנֹ֤ב אֹתוֹ֙ מִתּ֤וֹךְ בְּנֵֽי־ הַמֶּ֙לֶךְ֙ הַמָּמוֹתְתִים אֹת֥וֹ וְאֶת־ מֵינִקְתּ֖וֹ בַּחֲדַ֣ר הַמִּטּ֑וֹת וַיַּסְתִּ֧רוּ אֹת֛וֹ מִפְּנֵ֥י עֲתַלְיָ֖הוּ וְלֹ֥א הוּמָֽת׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tiq·qaḥ yə·hō·wō·še·ḇa‘ baṯ- ham·me·leḵ- yō·w·rām ’ă·ḥō·wṯ ’ă·ḥaz·yā·hū ’eṯ- yō·w·’āš ben- ’ă·ḥaz·yāh wat·tiḡ·nōḇ ’ō·ṯōw mit·tō·wḵ bə·nê- ham·me·leḵ ham·må̄·mō·ṯə·ṯīm ’ō·ṯōw wə·’eṯ- mê·niq·tōw ba·ḥă·ḏar ham·miṭ·ṭō·wṯ way·yas·ti·rū ’ō·ṯōw mip·pə·nê ‘ă·ṯal·yā·hū wə·lō hū·māṯ
verses.literal: But Jehosheba daughter of King Joram the sister of Ahaziah took Joash son of Ahaziah and stole him away from among the sons of the king who were being murdered - She put him and his nurse in a bedroom . . . to hide him from Athaliah and he was not killed

verses.original: וַיְהִ֤י אִתָּהּ֙ בֵּ֣ית יְהוָ֔ה מִתְחַבֵּ֖א שֵׁ֣שׁ שָׁנִ֑ים וַעֲתַלְיָ֖ה מֹלֶ֥כֶת עַל־ הָאָֽרֶץ׃פ
verses.transliteration: way·hî ’it·tāh bêṯ Yah·weh miṯ·ḥab·bê šêš šā·nîm wa·‘ă·ṯal·yāh mō·le·ḵeṯ ‘al- hā·’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: And Joash remained hidden with his nurse in the house of the LORD for six years while Athaliah ruled . . . the land

verses.original: וּבַשָּׁנָ֣ה הַ֠שְּׁבִיעִית שָׁלַ֨ח יְהוֹיָדָ֜ע וַיִּקַּ֣ח׀ אֶת־ שָׂרֵ֣י הַמֵּאיוֹת לַכָּרִי֙ וְלָ֣רָצִ֔ים וַיָּבֵ֥א אֹתָ֛ם אֵלָ֖יו בֵּ֣ית יְהוָ֑ה וַיִּכְרֹת֩ לָהֶ֨ם בְּרִ֜ית וַיַּשְׁבַּ֤ע אֹתָם֙ בְּבֵ֣ית יְהוָ֔ה וַיַּ֥רְא אֹתָ֖ם אֶת־ בֶּן־ הַמֶּֽלֶךְ׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇaš·šā·nāh haš·šə·ḇî·‘îṯ šā·laḥ yə·hō·w·yā·ḏā‘ way·yiq·qaḥ ’eṯ- śā·rê ham·mē·yōṯ lak·kā·rî wə·lā·rā·ṣîm way·yā·ḇê ’ō·ṯām ’ê·lāw bêṯ Yah·weh way·yiḵ·rōṯ lā·hem bə·rîṯ way·yaš·ba‘ ’ō·ṯām bə·ḇêṯ Yah·weh way·yar ’ō·ṯām ’eṯ- ben- ham·me·leḵ
verses.literal: Then in the seventh year Jehoiada sent for . . . the commanders of hundreds the Carites and the guards and had them brought - into the house of the LORD There . . . he made a covenant with them and put them under oath . . . He showed them the king’s son

verses.original: וַיְצַוֵּ֣ם לֵאמֹ֔ר זֶ֥ה הַדָּבָ֖ר אֲשֶׁ֣ר תַּעֲשׂ֑וּן הַשְּׁלִשִׁ֤ית מִכֶּם֙ בָּאֵ֣י הַשַּׁבָּ֔ת וְשֹׁ֣מְרֵ֔י מִשְׁמֶ֖רֶת בֵּ֥ית הַמֶּֽלֶךְ׃
verses.transliteration: way·ṣaw·wêm lê·mōr zeh had·dā·ḇār ’ă·šer ta·‘ă·śūn haš·šə·li·šîṯ mik·kem bā·’ê haš·šab·bāṯ wə·šō·mə·rê miš·me·reṯ bêṯ ham·me·leḵ
verses.literal: and commanded them . . . This . . . is what you are to do A third of you who come on duty on the Sabbath shall guard . . . the royal palace

verses.original: וְהַשְּׁלִשִׁית֙ בְּשַׁ֣עַר ס֔וּר וְהַשְּׁלִשִׁ֥ית בַּשַּׁ֖עַר אַחַ֣ר הָרָצִ֑ים וּשְׁמַרְתֶּ֛ם אֶת־ מִשְׁמֶ֥רֶת הַבַּ֖יִת מַסָּֽח׃
verses.transliteration: wə·haš·šə·li·šîṯ bə·ša·‘ar sūr wə·haš·šə·li·šîṯ baš·ša·‘ar ’a·ḥar hā·rā·ṣîm ū·šə·mar·tem ’eṯ- miš·me·reṯ hab·ba·yiṯ mas·sāḥ
verses.literal: a third shall be at the gate of Sur and a third at the gate behind the guards You are to take turns guarding - the temple

verses.original: וּשְׁתֵּ֤י הַיָּדוֹת֙ בָּכֶ֔ם כֹּ֖ל יֹצְאֵ֣י הַשַּׁבָּ֑ת וְשָֽׁמְר֛וּ אֶת־ מִשְׁמֶ֥רֶת בֵּית־ יְהוָ֖ה אֶל־ הַמֶּֽלֶךְ׃
verses.transliteration: ū·šə·tê hay·yā·ḏō·wṯ bā·ḵem kōl yō·ṣə·’ê haš·šab·bāṯ wə·šā·mə·rū ’eṯ- miš·me·reṯ bêṯ- Yah·weh ’el- ham·me·leḵ
verses.literal: the two divisions that would go off duty on the Sabbath are to guard - the house of the LORD for the king

verses.original: וְהִקַּפְתֶּ֨ם עַל־ הַמֶּ֜לֶךְ סָבִ֗יב אִ֚ישׁ וְכֵלָ֣יו בְּיָד֔וֹ וְהַבָּ֥א אֶל־ הַשְּׂדֵר֖וֹת יוּמָ֑ת וִהְי֥וּ אֶת־ הַמֶּ֖לֶךְ בְּצֵאת֥וֹ וּבְבֹאֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hiq·qap̄·tem ‘al- ham·me·leḵ sā·ḇîḇ ’îš wə·ḵê·lāw bə·yā·ḏōw wə·hab·bā ’el- haś·śə·ḏê·rō·wṯ yū·māṯ wih·yū ’eṯ- ham·me·leḵ bə·ṣê·ṯōw ū·ḇə·ḇō·’ōw
verses.literal: You must surround . . . the king . . . with weapons in hand and anyone who approaches . . . the ranks must be put to death You must stay close to the king wherever he goes . . .

verses.original: וַֽיַּעֲשׂ֞וּ שָׂרֵ֣י הַמֵּאיוֹת כְּכֹ֣ל אֲשֶׁר־ צִוָּה֮ יְהוֹיָדָ֣ע הַכֹּהֵן֒ וַיִּקְחוּ֙ אִ֣ישׁ אֶת־ אֲנָשָׁ֔יו בָּאֵ֣י הַשַּׁבָּ֔ת עִ֖ם יֹצְאֵ֣י הַשַּׁבָּ֑ת וַיָּבֹ֖אוּ אֶל־ יְהוֹיָדָ֥ע הַכֹּהֵֽן׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘ă·śū śā·rê ham·mē·yōṯ kə·ḵōl ’ă·šer- ṣiw·wāh yə·hō·w·yā·ḏā‘ hak·kō·hên way·yiq·ḥū ’îš ’eṯ- ’ă·nā·šāw bā·’ê haš·šab·bāṯ ‘im yō·ṣə·’ê haš·šab·bāṯ way·yā·ḇō·’ū ’el- yə·hō·w·yā·ḏā‘ hak·kō·hên
verses.literal: So the commanders of hundreds did everything that Jehoiada the priest had ordered Each of them took his men those coming on duty on the Sabbath and those going off duty . . . and came to Jehoiada the priest

verses.original: וַיִּתֵּ֨ן הַכֹּהֵ֜ן לְשָׂרֵ֣י הַמֵּאיוֹת אֶֽת־ הַחֲנִית֙ וְאֶת־ הַשְּׁלָטִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֖ר לַמֶּ֣לֶךְ דָּוִ֑ד אֲשֶׁ֖ר בְּבֵ֥ית יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yit·tên hak·kō·hên lə·śā·rê ham·mē·yōṯ ’eṯ- ha·ḥă·nîṯ wə·’eṯ- haš·šə·lā·ṭîm ’ă·šer lam·me·leḵ dā·wiḏ ’ă·šer bə·ḇêṯ Yah·weh
verses.literal: Then the priest gave to the commanders of hundreds the spears and shields of King David from the house of the LORD

verses.original: וַיַּעַמְד֨וּ הָרָצִ֜ים אִ֣ישׁ׀ וְכֵלָ֣יו בְּיָד֗וֹ מִכֶּ֨תֶף הַבַּ֤יִת הַיְמָנִית֙ עַד־ כֶּ֤תֶף הַבַּ֙יִת֙ הַשְּׂמָאלִ֔ית לַמִּזְבֵּ֖חַ וְלַבָּ֑יִת עַל־ הַמֶּ֖לֶךְ סָבִֽיב׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘am·ḏū hā·rā·ṣîm ’îš wə·ḵê·lāw bə·yā·ḏōw mik·ke·ṯep̄ hab·ba·yiṯ hay·mā·nîṯ ‘aḏ- ke·ṯep̄ hab·ba·yiṯ haś·śə·mā·lîṯ lam·miz·bê·aḥ wə·lab·bā·yiṯ ‘al- ham·me·leḵ sā·ḇîḇ
verses.literal: And the guards . . . stood with weapons in hand surrounding the king by the altar and the temple from the south side to the north side of the temple

verses.original: וַיּוֹצִ֣א אֶת־ בֶּן־ הַמֶּ֗לֶךְ וַיִּתֵּ֤ן עָלָיו֙ אֶת־ הַנֵּ֙זֶר֙ וְאֶת־ הָ֣עֵד֔וּת וַיַּמְלִ֥כוּ אֹת֖וֹ וַיִּמְשָׁחֻ֑הוּ וַיַּכּוּ־ כָ֔ף וַיֹּאמְר֖וּ יְחִ֥י הַמֶּֽלֶךְ׃ס
verses.transliteration: way·yō·w·ṣi ’eṯ- ben- ham·me·leḵ way·yit·tên ‘ā·lāw ’eṯ- han·nê·zer wə·’eṯ- hā·‘ê·ḏūṯ way·yam·li·ḵū ’ō·ṯōw way·yim·šā·ḥu·hū way·yak·kū- ḵāp̄ way·yō·mə·rū yə·ḥî ham·me·leḵ
verses.literal: Then Jehoiada brought out the king’s son put the crown on him presented him with the Testimony and proclaimed him king They anointed him and the people clapped their hands and declared Long live the king

verses.original: וַתִּשְׁמַ֣ע עֲתַלְיָ֔ה אֶת־ ק֥וֹל הָֽרָצִ֖ין הָעָ֑ם וַתָּבֹ֥א אֶל־ הָעָ֖ם בֵּ֥ית יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tiš·ma‘ ‘ă·ṯal·yāh ’eṯ- qō·wl hā·rā·ṣîn hā·‘ām wat·tā·ḇō ’el- hā·‘ām bêṯ Yah·weh
verses.literal: When Athaliah heard the noise from the guards and the people she went out to the people in the house of the LORD

verses.original: וַתֵּ֡רֶא וְהִנֵּ֣ה הַמֶּלֶךְ֩ עֹמֵ֨ד עַֽל־ הָעַמּ֜וּד כַּמִּשְׁפָּ֗ט וְהַשָּׂרִ֤ים וְהַחֲצֹֽצְרוֹת֙ אֶל־ הַמֶּ֔לֶךְ וְכָל־ עַ֤ם הָאָ֙רֶץ֙ שָׂמֵ֔חַ וְתֹקֵ֖עַ בַּחֲצֹֽצְר֑וֹת וַתִּקְרַ֤ע עֲתַלְיָה֙ אֶת־ בְּגָדֶ֔יהָ וַתִּקְרָ֖א קֶ֥שֶׁר קָֽשֶׁר׃ס
verses.transliteration: wat·tê·re wə·hin·nêh ham·me·leḵ ‘ō·mêḏ ‘al- hā·‘am·mūḏ kam·miš·pāṭ wə·haś·śā·rîm wə·ha·ḥă·ṣō·ṣə·rō·wṯ ’el- ham·me·leḵ wə·ḵāl ‘am hā·’ā·reṣ śā·mê·aḥ wə·ṯō·qê·a‘ ba·ḥă·ṣō·ṣə·rō·wṯ wat·tiq·ra‘ ‘ă·ṯal·yāh ’eṯ- bə·ḡā·ḏe·hā wat·tiq·rā qe·šer qā·šer
verses.literal: And she looked out and saw the king standing by the pillar according to the custom The officers and trumpeters were beside the king and all the people of the land were rejoicing and blowing trumpets Then Athaliah tore her clothes and screamed Treason Treason

verses.original: וַיְצַו֩ יְהוֹיָדָ֨ע הַכֹּהֵ֜ן אֶת־ שָׂרֵ֥י הַמֵּיאוֹת פְּקֻדֵ֣י הַחַ֗יִל וַיֹּ֤אמֶר אֲלֵיהֶם֙ הוֹצִ֤יאוּ אֹתָהּ֙ אֶל־ מִבֵּ֣ית לַשְּׂדֵרֹ֔ת וְהַבָּ֥א אַחֲרֶ֖יהָ הָמֵ֣ת בֶּחָ֑רֶב כִּ֚י אָמַ֣ר הַכֹּהֵ֔ן אַל־ תּוּמַ֖ת בֵּ֥ית יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·ṣaw yə·hō·w·yā·ḏā‘ hak·kō·hên ’eṯ- śā·rê ham·mē·ʾōṯ pə·qu·ḏê ha·ḥa·yil way·yō·mer ’ă·lê·hem hō·w·ṣî·’ū ’ō·ṯāh ’el- mib·bêṯ laś·śə·ḏê·rōṯ wə·hab·bā ’a·ḥă·re·hā hā·mêṯ be·ḥā·reḇ kî ’ā·mar hak·kō·hên ’al- tū·maṯ bêṯ Yah·weh
verses.literal: And Jehoiada the priest ordered the commanders of hundreds in charge of the army Bring her out - . . . between the ranks and put to the sword anyone who follows her For the priest had said She must not be put to death in the house of the LORD

verses.original: וַיָּשִׂ֤מוּ לָהּ֙ יָדַ֔יִם וַתָּב֛וֹא דֶּֽרֶךְ־ מְב֥וֹא הַסּוּסִ֖ים בֵּ֣ית הַמֶּ֑לֶךְ וַתּוּמַ֖ת שָֽׁם׃ס
verses.transliteration: way·yā·śi·mū lāh yā·ḏa·yim wat·tā·ḇō·w de·reḵ- mə·ḇō·w has·sū·sîm bêṯ ham·me·leḵ wat·tū·maṯ šām
verses.literal: So they seized Athaliah as she reached . . . the horses’ entrance to the palace grounds . . . and there she was put to death

verses.original: וַיִּכְרֹ֨ת יְהוֹיָדָ֜ע אֶֽת־ הַבְּרִ֗ית בֵּ֤ין יְהוָה֙ וּבֵ֤ין הַמֶּ֙לֶךְ֙ וּבֵ֣ין הָעָ֔ם לִהְי֥וֹת לְעָ֖ם לַֽיהוָ֑ה וּבֵ֥ין הַמֶּ֖לֶךְ וּבֵ֥ין הָעָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiḵ·rōṯ yə·hō·w·yā·ḏā‘ ’eṯ- hab·bə·rîṯ bên Yah·weh ū·ḇên ham·me·leḵ ū·ḇên hā·‘ām lih·yō·wṯ lə·‘ām Yah·weh ū·ḇên ham·me·leḵ ū·ḇên hā·‘ām
verses.literal: Then Jehoiada made a covenant between the LORD and the king . . . and the people that they would be the LORD’s people He also made a covenant between the king and the people

verses.original: וַיָּבֹ֣אוּ כָל־ עַם֩ הָאָ֨רֶץ בֵּית־ הַבַּ֜עַל וַֽיִּתְּצֻ֗הוּ אֶת־ מִזְבְּחֹתוֹ וְאֶת־ צְלָמָיו֙ שִׁבְּר֣וּ הֵיטֵ֔ב וְאֵ֗ת מַתָּן֙ כֹּהֵ֣ן הַבַּ֔עַל הָרְג֖וּ לִפְנֵ֣י הַֽמִּזְבְּח֑וֹת וַיָּ֧שֶׂם הַכֹּהֵ֛ן פְּקֻדּ֖וֹת עַל־ בֵּ֥ית יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·ḇō·’ū ḵāl ‘am hā·’ā·reṣ bêṯ- hab·ba·‘al way·yit·tə·ṣu·hū ’eṯ- miz·bə·ḥō·ṯō wə·’eṯ- ṣə·lā·māw šib·bə·rū hê·ṭêḇ wə·’êṯ mat·tān kō·hên hab·ba·‘al hā·rə·ḡū lip̄·nê ham·miz·bə·ḥō·wṯ way·yā·śem hak·kō·hên pə·qud·dō·wṯ ‘al- bêṯ Yah·weh
verses.literal: So all the people of the land went to the temple of Baal and tore it down They smashed the altars and idols to pieces . . . and they killed Mattan the priest of Baal in front of the altars And Jehoiada the priest posted guards for the house of the LORD

verses.original: וַיִּקַּ֣ח אֶת־ שָׂרֵ֣י הַ֠מֵּאוֹת וְאֶת־ הַכָּרִ֨י וְאֶת־ הָרָצִ֜ים וְאֵ֣ת׀ כָּל־ עַ֣ם הָאָ֗רֶץ וַיֹּרִ֤ידוּ אֶת־ הַמֶּ֙לֶךְ֙ מִבֵּ֣ית יְהוָ֔ה וַיָּב֛וֹאוּ דֶּֽרֶך־ שַׁ֥עַר הָרָצִ֖ים בֵּ֣ית הַמֶּ֑לֶךְ וַיֵּ֖שֶׁב עַל־ כִּסֵּ֥א הַמְּלָכִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiq·qaḥ ’eṯ- śā·rê ham·mê·’ō·wṯ wə·’eṯ- hak·kā·rî wə·’eṯ- hā·rā·ṣîm wə·’êṯ kāl- ‘am hā·’ā·reṣ way·yō·rî·ḏū ’eṯ- ham·me·leḵ mib·bêṯ Yah·weh way·yā·ḇō·w·’ū de·reḵ- ša·ʿar hā·rā·ṣîm bêṯ ham·me·leḵ way·yê·šeḇ ‘al- kis·sê ham·mə·lā·ḵîm
verses.literal: He took with him the commanders of hundreds the Carites the guards and all the people of the land and they brought the king down from the house of the LORD and entered the royal palace by way of the Gate of the Guards Then Joash took his seat on the royal throne

verses.original: וַיִּשְׂמַ֥ח כָּל־ עַם־ הָאָ֖רֶץ וְהָעִ֣יר שָׁקָ֑טָה וְאֶת־ עֲתַלְיָ֛הוּ הֵמִ֥יתוּ בַחֶ֖רֶב בֵּ֥ית מֶלֶךְ׃ס
verses.transliteration: way·yiś·maḥ kāl- ‘am- hā·’ā·reṣ wə·hā·‘îr šā·qā·ṭāh wə·’eṯ- ‘ă·ṯal·yā·hū hê·mî·ṯū ḇa·ḥe·reḇ bêṯ mɛ·lɛḵ
verses.literal: and all the people of the land rejoiced And the city was quiet because Athaliah had been put to the sword at the royal palace

verses.original: בֶּן־ שֶׁ֥בַע שָׁנִ֖ים יְהוֹאָ֥שׁ בְּמָלְכֽוֹ׃פ
verses.transliteration: ben- še·ḇa‘ šā·nîm yə·hō·w·’āš bə·mā·lə·ḵōw
verses.literal: Joash was seven years old . . . when he became king
